text.p: These are the main stories in the Angolan press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- A World Bank and International Monetary Fund mission is due in Angola next month to assess steps taken by the government to reconstruct the economy, Angola's Ambassador to the United States Antonio Franca Ndalu said.
- Diplomats, the United Nations and government officials on Tuesday attended a ceremony in memory of Angola's first president Agostinho Neto who died on September 10, 1979.

- UNITA on Tuesday handed 41 tonnes of heavy weapons in the Lunda Norte province in terms of a peace timetable between the government and UNITA to end two decades of war. The process of handing in weapons began in July in the south and is to continue into the central regions.
